name: impostor-c64
title: Definitely not an Impostor
author: Teletype Games
desc: Norman Reds lives the same day over and over - wake up, walk to the office, work, coffee, walk home, sleep - while his work productivity, impostor syndrome and burnout push and pull. Bit by bit he notices the seams of the simulation he lives in: nine steps of ASCENSION, a commute that glitches apart and, at the end, the choice to break the cycle. The C64 port of the TIC-80 game.
